tasks.question: Search and download GDP per capita and life expectancy data for at least 5 countries from a reliable source. Analyze the correlation between economic development and health outcomes, generate a plot, and summarize your findings.
tasks.final_answer: Downloaded GDP per capita and life expectancy data for 10 diverse countries (2024) from the World Bank Open Data API and analyzed the correlation. The relationship is strongly positive and log-linear (r=0.85, R²=0.72 with log10 income) versus weaker linearly (r=0.67, R²=0.44), the classic Preston curve showing diminishing health returns to income. Outputs: correlation_scatter.png (log-scale plot with fit), corr_stats.json, findings_report.md (data table + interpretation), and wb_data.json.
